ig_caption:
The agent never reads your code. It reads your tool description 🧐

Real test: same model (qwen2.5 3B), the same 3 tools from my MCP server, one request: "Login is broken for customers. What do we know?"
❌ vague descriptions ("Search.", "Orders."): no tool called. It asked ME for more info, while the answer sat in the ticket system.
✅ real descriptions: it calls search_tickets.

Your tool description is a prompt. Write it like one.

Part 3/5 of MCP & Tools. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
